title: pretty REYA|Plus Size Cold Shoulder Formal Bridesmaid Dress with Side Slit
descriptionHtml:
This plus size long romantic bridesmaid dress features an cold-shoulder neckline and floor-length skirt with a thigh-high slit. The stretchy chiffon fabric will make your curving figure look adorable. Suitable for any wedding, evening, party and similar occasion, you can pair it up with chic jewelry and get ready for comfort and style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric: he garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
